job.name: l4_host_c4
job.meaning: айтишник-сова ~28: круглые очки, растрёпанные тёмные волосы, лёгкая щетина, томатное худи, провод от ноутбука не нужен; фон зелёный; живой человек-типаж (не модель, не сток), фотореализм, однотонный фон палитры «Свежий рынок»; по пояс, по центру, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки; без надписей
job.prompt: Photorealistic photograph of a real everyday person with a vivid, recognisable CHARACTER (a memorable type from real life, like a hero of a warm TV commercial — NOT a fashion model, NOT a stock-photo office worker). Vertical 9:16, waist-up, the person in the centre facing the camera, shoulders square, hands out of frame. Expression: lively eyes full of personality, but the face NEUTRAL like in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Headroom: top of the head about 16% of the frame height below the upper edge; the face is large and sharp. Colours from the attached board «Свежий рынок» (palette only, do NOT copy the man on it): leaf green #23A455, tomato red #FF4B2E, mustard #FFC531, cream #FFF6E9 — clothes and details use these colours. Background: a plain seamless backdrop in ONE palette colour (given below), bright even daylight-like lighting, natural skin texture, cheerful but natural look. No text, no logos, no brand names, no badges, nothing covering the face. Type: a night-owl IT guy of about 28, round tortoiseshell glasses, tousled dark hair, light stubble, slightly tired but sharp eyes, a tomato-red hoodie over a mustard tee. Backdrop: leaf green #23A455.
